title.value: Biomedical image analysis competitions: The state of current participation practice
title.justification: The title accurately reflects the focus of the paper on the state of participation in biomedical image analysis competitions.
title.quote: Biomedical image analysis competitions: The state of current participation practice

extractions.description: This paper analyzes the state of participation in biomedical image analysis competitions, focusing on challenges conducted at IEEE ISBI 2021 and MICCAI 2021. It examines participant motivations, strategies, and the algorithmic approaches used, highlighting the predominance of deep learning solutions.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The paper primarily focuses on biomedical image analysis competitions, their structure, and participation practices, without a central emphasis on Climate or Ecological Sustainable Development.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: The number of international benchmarking competitions is steadily increasing in various fields of machine learning (ML) research and practice. So far, however, little is known about the common practice as well as bottlenecks faced by the community in tackling the research questions posed.

primary_category.justification: The paper does not primarily address any Climate or Ecological Sustainable Development themes. It is centered around the practices and dynamics of biomedical image analysis competitions.
primary_category.quote: This white paper presents the survey design and the summary of responses.

secondary_categories.justification: As the central theme of the paper does not include Climate or Ecological Sustainable Development, no secondary categories are identified within these themes.
secondary_categories.quote: This white paper presents the survey design and the summary of responses.

primary_sub_category.justification: There is no specific sub-category within Climate or Ecological Sustainable Development that this paper addresses primarily.
primary_sub_category.quote: The survey covered participants’ expertise and working environments, their chosen strategies, as well as algorithm characteristics.

secondary_sub_categories.justification: As there are no secondary themes related to Climate or Ecological Sustainable Development in the paper, no sub-categories apply.
secondary_sub_categories.quote: According to our results, knowledge exchange was the primary incentive (70%) for participation, while the reception of prize money played only a minor role (16%).

new_primary_category.justification: No new Climate or Ecological Sustainable Development category is necessary as the paper does not address this area.
new_primary_category.quote: To shed light on the status quo of algorithm development in the specific field of biomedical imaging analysis, we designed an international survey that was issued to all participants of challenges conducted in conjunction with the IEEE ISBI 2021 and MICCAI 2021 conferences.

new_primary_sub_category.justification: No new sub-category creation is warranted as the paper does not introduce novel aspects related to Climate or Ecological Sustainable Development.
new_primary_sub_category.quote: A median of 72% challenge participants took part in the survey.
